meanings.en: to run (in various directions or habitually)
meanings.note: вокруг меня бегала = she was running after me

examples.trans: The children are running around in the yard.

examples.text: Это она со мной познакомилась! Вокруг меня бегала.
examples.trans: She was the one who came up to me! She was running after me.

+ accusative (where to). Core Russian prep meaning 'in, into' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.

meanings.note: About people.
in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: + genitive.

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!
examples.trans: And the herbs in the sacks burned. Because of you!

meanings.note: + dative. Core Russian prep meaning 'to, towards' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: In questions.
in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!

examples.trans: When I grow up, I'll be the mayor.

examples.trans: Say it to my face. Why do you hate me so much?

+ genitive. Core Russian part meaning 'no; there isn't' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)
meanings.note: Поговорить с + instrumental. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'говорить').

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.

meanings.en: to think it over, to give it a thought
meanings.note: Once, for a while.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
Go on, come by later! Later!

meanings.note: Informal. Core Russian interj meaning 'bye' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: Asks about the reason.

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

прилететь.gloss: to arrive (by air), to fly in

meanings.en: to arrive by plane, to fly in
meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'лететь').

examples.trans: We flew in for the deal.

examples.text: Мы сюда зачем прилетели? Я сразу сказал: с ним ничего не получится.
examples.trans: What did we even fly out here for? I said from the start: nothing will come of it with him.
